capabilities.name: Repository change detection
capabilities.actual_implementation: C42.27 evidence_planner.Planner.plan() -> changed_files via git diff or explicit --changed
capabilities.real_world_dependency: git executable for diff; falls back to explicit --changed
capabilities.simulation_only_behavior: None - works against real repo state
capabilities.known_limitation: Requires git history; explicit --changed bypasses detection

capabilities.name: Verification Graph construction
capabilities.actual_implementation: C42.27 graph_model.VerificationGraph with cross-layer-map.json as source
capabilities.output_contract: VerificationGraph with tasks, surfaces, capabilities, edges
capabilities.real_world_dependency: cross-layer-map.json must be current (regenerated via verification-reconcile.yml)
capabilities.known_limitation: Graph drift detection (C42.24) required for currency

capabilities.name: Capability impact resolution
capabilities.input_contract: Changed files -> affected components -> capability mapping
capabilities.known_limitation: Mapping must be manually maintained; drift detection exists

capabilities.name: Evidence invalidation
capabilities.known_limitation: Rule set is fixed; new drift kinds need new rules

capabilities.name: Evidence reuse
capabilities.actual_implementation: C42.28 evidence_reuse: ReuseDisposition enum + reconcile() produces ReusedMeasurement
capabilities.input_contract: Prior measurements + current fingerprints + invalidation verdicts
capabilities.output_contract: ReusedMeasurement list with component, measurement_id, reason
capabilities.known_limitation: Prior measurements must be manually curated/updated

capabilities.name: Planner generation
capabilities.output_contract: VerificationPlan with selected tasks, exclusions, count, metadata
capabilities.known_limitation: Planner is deterministic but scope depends on evidence freshness

capabilities.name: Executable-plan generation
capabilities.output_contract: ExecutablePlan with PlannedTask list, count, scope enforcement metadata
capabilities.simulation_only_behavior: None - produces real executable plan structure
capabilities.known_limitation: Only mutation tasks currently; other task kinds stubbed

capabilities.name: Targeted verification
capabilities.real_world_dependency: mutmut 3.7.0 in .venv; target component source code
capabilities.known_limitation: mutmut local execution has known flakiness; CI is authoritative

capabilities.name: Evidence capture
capabilities.known_limitation: Local mutmut output parsing may differ from CI

capabilities.name: CI evidence ingestion
capabilities.actual_implementation: C42.29 ci_evidence.py: build_ci_bindings() -> parse workflows -> load_ci_evidence() -> validate_and_decide() -> ingest_ci_evidence()
capabilities.input_contract: CIEvidenceRecord (from workflow artifacts) + CIRepositoryContext (current repo state)
capabilities.output_contract: CIReuseDecision (reusable boolean, disposition, reasons) + ingested ExecutionEvidence
capabilities.tests: runtime/tests/test_m9_c42_29.py (30 tests - 8 scenarios CI-A through CI-H)
capabilities.real_world_dependency: CI workflow must emit artifacts in expected locations; workflow commands must match COMMAND_MATCHERS
capabilities.simulation_only_behavior: Tests use synthetic CI records; no real CI execution
capabilities.known_limitation: No live CI integration test; artifact paths hardcoded in workflow; requires manual CI run to validate end-to-end

capabilities.name: Local/CI evidence correlation
capabilities.input_contract: Local ExecutionEvidence + CI CIEvidenceRecord + both reuse decisions
capabilities.output_contract: EquivalenceReport with semantically_equivalent boolean + 6 dimension details
capabilities.persisted_artifact: Correlation output in forensic record / diagnostic report
capabilities.real_world_dependency: Both local and CI evidence must exist for same component/task
capabilities.known_limitation: No real CI-local pair has been validated; equivalence is theoretical

capabilities.name: ForensicExecutionRecord generation
capabilities.actual_implementation: C42.28 executor_pipeline.build_forensic_record() -> ForensicExecutionRecord with 12 causal stages
capabilities.simulation_only_behavior: Diagnostic mode (forensic-diagnose) creates synthetic record without execution
capabilities.known_limitation: Diagnostic mode skips actual mutation execution

capabilities.name: Diagnostic Agent
capabilities.input_contract: ForensicExecutionRecord dict + optional CI correlation dict
capabilities.output_contract: DiagnosticReport with q1-q9 answers, RecordValidation, Explainability
capabilities.tests: runtime/tests/test_m9_c42_30.py (25 tests - 9 questions, verdicts, uncertainties, determinism)
capabilities.real_world_dependency: Complete forensic record with all stages
capabilities.known_limitation: Agent is read-only; never executes verification

capabilities.name: Survivor classification
capabilities.input_contract: SurvivorEvidence (survivor_id, component, location, operator, snippets, status, notes, covering_tests)
capabilities.real_world_dependency: Actual mutmut survivor data with snippets and covering tests
capabilities.known_limitation: Classification rules are heuristic-based; equivalent mutant detection requires upstream notes

capabilities.name: Strengthening proposal generation
capabilities.output_contract: StrengtheningProposal with behavioral_hypothesis, proposed_test, validation_command, acceptance_criteria
capabilities.real_world_dependency: Class-A survivor evidence from real mutation runs
capabilities.known_limitation: Proposals are test skeletons (...); human must author test body

capabilities.name: Targeted strengthening validation
capabilities.actual_implementation: C42.31 strengthening.targeted_revalidation() via C42.28 executor bridge
capabilities.output_contract: RevalidationOutcome with before/after killed, target_mutant_killed, kill_regressions, accepted
capabilities.real_world_dependency: Actual mutmut execution on component with proposed test added
capabilities.known_limitation: Requires human to actually add the proposed test before validation; --stub bypasses real execution

capabilities.name: Certification decision
capabilities.real_world_dependency: All upstream evidence must be valid
capabilities.simulation_only_behavior: Master scenarios in test_m9_c42_29.py use synthetic end-to-end runs
capabilities.known_limitation: Verdict depends on complete forensic record; diagnostic mode skips execution

summary.primary_gap: CI evidence ingestion (J) - lacks live CI validation; all other capabilities are implemented and tested against synthetic scenarios
